messages:
maria: Heads-up — got a call with Gaudi partner this morning. They warned of a 4–6 week potential delay on the 4U racks we were counting on for the marketplace pilot. This affects SI onboarding windows and any co-announce timelines. Need an early-warning plan.

tony: ugh ok. do we know which SKUs specifically? H100/H200/B200? or just Gaudi?

maria: mainly Gaudi instances for the reseller images, plus Mi300 nodes we were expecting in late May might slip to mid-June. H100 supply is fine for now, B200 is uncertain in APAC.

priya: thanks for flagging. proposed immediate steps: 1) short partner readiness matrix (public vs embargo vs marketplace listing) 2) stall/fast-track options per SKU 3) a two-week rolling comms cadence with SIs so they can reschedule integration sprints.

sam: can we get a minimal CSV we can drop into the partner portal? I'll sync with marketplace ops. e.g.

```
sku,expected_delivery,impact,recommended_action
Gaudi-4U,2026-06-10,delay,move-to-staggered-wave
Mi300-64C,2026-06-15,possible_delay,hold-marketing-announce
H100-80GB,2026-05-01,on_track,proceed
B200-16X,2026-05-20,regional_risk,notify-APAC-SIs
```

priya: perfect. let's add a column for embargo_allowed and si_integration_blocker (y/n). helps runbook decisions.

maria: +1. also need to coordinate joint announcement owners — marketing wants a single date but ops needs flexibility. If Gaudi slips we should offer a phased announcement: marketplace listing for H100/MI300 in wave1 and Gaudi in wave2 with clear communication to SIs.

tony: agree on phased announce. can engineering support a canary image for SI testing that doesn't require the full rack? might reduce blocker severity. @sam any infra comments?

sam: yes, we can spin a reduced-capacity canary for SI validation (single-node Gaudi image + emulated multi-node KV). Not perfect but good enough for integration smoke tests. Will need ~3 days to image + test.

maria: ok timeline then:
- by EOD tomorrow: priya to share updated CSV (+ embargo/integration cols)
- +3 days: sam to deliver canary image and test notes
- +7 days: partner comms draft for phased announce (marketing + partnerships)

priya: noted. I'll populate CSV and send to partnerships-marketing channel for review.

ops-bot: calendar: created event "Partner Roadmap: early-warning sync" on 2026-05-02 15:00 UTC and invited @maria @tony @priya @sam

tony: can we also get a quick risk score per partner (1–5) so PMs know who to prioritize? simple formula: supply_risk + si_dependency + regional_risk.

maria: yes. priya, add risk_score column. We'll present to PM and marketplace ops on Friday.

priya: adding now. will post the CSV link shortly. :wave:
